title: parse frontier messages
description:
I want to be able to parse a new message.

Example:

```
MapTap Frontier
Level 8 · 31 rounds · 3:17
Fell at Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, India · 2,829 pts
www.maptap.gg/frontier
```

Investigate for me how this would integrate with our existing scores DB.

Can we simply add to it? Do we need a new schema? etc.
notes:
Investigation outcome (2026-06-16):

Frontier reuses the `scores` table with `mode='frontier'`. Add migration 7 with three nullable columns: `frontier_level INTEGER`, `frontier_rounds INTEGER`, `frontier_location TEXT`. Reuse `time_spent_ms` (3:17 -> 197000). Reuse `final_score` for pts; lift the 1000 cap for frontier mode only in MaptapScore::validate(). Derive `date` from Discord posted_at (no date in the Frontier message).

Cadence: unlimited runs/day, every message is its own row. The UNIQUE(user_id,guild_id,date,mode) constraint was already dropped in migration 5, so this works as-is.

Leaderboard: permanent only, best run per user, rank by final_score DESC then posted_at ASC (earlier tiebreak wins). No daily/weekly view.

Message format (URL is on line 4, not line 1 — different from daily/challenge):

```
MapTap Frontier
Level 8 · 31 rounds · 3:17
Fell at Kurnool, Andhra Pradesh, India · 2,829 pts
www.maptap.gg/frontier
```

Notes for parser: pts is comma-formatted (2,829); time is M:SS; location is free-text after "Fell at " before " · ".
close_reason: Investigation complete. Follow-up work tracked in maptapbot-86s (spec), maptapbot-bgi (parsing+storage), maptapbot-qpz (leaderboard command). Design captured in notes.

title: frontier: /leaderboard_frontier command
description:
Add /leaderboard_frontier plugin command (permanent leaderboard, best run per user).

Scope:
- New repository/db query: per user, the row with the highest final_score for mode='frontier' (tiebreak: earliest posted_at), JOIN users, exclude banned, ORDER BY final_score DESC, posted_at ASC
- Plugin command in src/plugins/leaderboard_plugin/ (or a new frontier sub-plugin if it fits better — judgment call)
- Embed format following the existing leaderboard pattern; display pts, level, rounds, time, location for each entry. No daily/weekly variant
- Wire registration in main.rs if a new plugin is created
- Tests

title: frontier: parsing + storage
description:
Implement Frontier message parsing and DB storage.

Scope:
- Add GameMode::Frontier to src/models.rs
- Extend MaptapScore (or via a frontier extras sub-struct) with level/rounds/location; derive date from Discord posted_at when mode is Frontier
- Make MaptapScore::validate() mode-aware: skip s1-s5 checks and the (s1+s2)+s3*2+(s4+s5)*3 formula for Frontier; lift the 1000 cap for Frontier only
- Add parse_frontier_message() in src/parser.rs — handles 'MapTap Frontier' header, 'Level N · M rounds · M:SS', 'Fell at <location> · N,NNN pts', and 'www.maptap.gg/frontier' URL line (URL is line 4, not line 1)
- DB migration 7 in src/db.rs: ALTER TABLE scores ADD COLUMN frontier_level INTEGER, frontier_rounds INTEGER, frontier_location TEXT (all nullable). Update insert_score and all ScoreRow-returning queries
- Wire parser into handler.rs::message() dispatch alongside the existing daily/challenge parsers
- Tests in src/tests/
